updates.title: 2 Denial of Service Vulnerabilities Patched in Azure Active Directory
updates.summary: Microsoft released patches for two denial-of-service vulnerabilities affecting Azure Active Directory (CVE-2026-50652 and CVE-2026-50653). Organizations should apply these updates promptly to prevent potential service disruptions from exploitation.

updates.title: 5 Denial of Service Vulnerabilities Patched in Active Directory Federation Services
updates.summary: Microsoft patched five denial-of-service vulnerabilities in ADFS (CVE-2026-50304, CVE-2026-50368, CVE-2026-50324, CVE-2026-50355, CVE-2026-50411, CVE-2026-50647). Organizations running ADFS should prioritize deploying these security updates to prevent potential service downtime.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Restricts External Email Processing in Copilot
updates.summary: Purview DLP capabilities will expand to block Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from processing emails sent from external senders, providing real-time data protection controls. This enhancement helps organizations prevent sensitive data from being exposed through AI-assisted email analysis.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Event Data Enriches Defender Alerts Graph API
updates.summary: DLP rule match event details are being integrated into the Graph API alongside existing alert data, enabling seamless SIEM integration and custom reporting. This unifies DLP event data access and simplifies compliance automation workflows for administrators.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management Enhances Data Security Triage Agent
updates.summary: IRM's Data Security Triage Agent is receiving improvements to activity pattern summaries and user risk analysis, enabling faster and more accurate insider threat investigation. Enhanced investigation capabilities help security teams identify and respond to potential data leakage and IP theft risks more effectively.
